Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers, names, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL5727045. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno to require available canonical SMILES. Return columns chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
